properties.name: Apply Pseudonymisation Plan
properties.description: Apply a pseudonymisation plan to table records, replacing direct identifiers with reversible pseudonyms while preserving all other fields.

properties.name: pseudonymisation_applier
properties.description: Applies a pseudonymisation plan to table records and returns pseudonymised table records. Detected direct-identifier values are replaced with reversible pseudonyms, while non-target fields are preserved.
